record.question: Define most efficient estimator. A random sample (X1, X2, X3, X4, X5) of size 5 is drawn from a normal population with unknown mean μ. Consider the following estimators to estimate μ: (i) t1 = (X1 + X2 + X3 + X4 + X5)/5 (ii) t2 = (X1 + X2)/2 + X3 (iii) t3 = (2X1 + X2 + λX3)/3. Where λ is such that t3 is an unbiased estimator of μ. Find λ. Are t1 and t2 unbiased? State giving reasons the estimators which is best among t1, t2 and t3.
